items.title: Local Visibility Is Now Four Separate Games – brightonSEO October 2026
items.summary: A short intro on the four new games next to Google Maps, then a bullet list of what the talk covers. That includes the correction to the April data (US direction requests rose 31.3%, they didn’t fall 43%) and the “Five things to do by Monday” slide. It ends with a link to gmbapi.com
